svg.title: From annotation text to typed semantics
svg.desc: Five layers: syntax, packages, declarations and resolution, semantic layers, generators and plugins. Annotation names are compared once, in the resolution layer; string matchers and per-target support records are removed.
svg.text: From annotation text to typed semantics
Each layer consumes only the typed output of the layer above. Names are compared exactly once, in layer 3.
applications are just names and constant expressions here
resolution, digests (manifest included), provenance per declaration
-> ResolvedAnnotation { decl, args: typed, key: SemanticKey }
Semantic layers: match SemanticKey, build typed models
declare capabilities and the plugin: keys they implement
driver checks once: required (derived from used keys) must be supported
plugin: keys are handed to the named plugin as typed values
